subject: Fraud & Scams
title: What to Do If You've Been Scammed
description: A fast breakdown of What to Do If You've Been Scammed for builders.

hook.text: You realize you've been scammed. The next 60 minutes are critical for damage control.

buildup.text: Contact your bank immediately to freeze accounts and dispute charges. Speed matters.

discovery.text: File reports with the FTC, local police, and the FBI's IC3 — even if recovery seems unlikely.

twist.text: Reporting helps law enforcement track patterns and shut down operations, even if your money is gone.

climax.text: Change all passwords, enable 2FA, and monitor your credit. The scammer may try again.

punchline.text: Getting scammed isn't shameful. Staying silent helps the scammer.

quiz.question: What should you do first if you realize you've been scammed?
options: Post about it on social media
Contact your bank to freeze accounts and dispute charges
Wait to see if the scammer contacts you again
